data.config.yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://agentgateway.dev/schema/config
gateways:
  default:
    port: 4000
routes:
  # Entry hop to the in-process LLM listener: one overall budget and no
  # per-hop timeout. With a per-hop timeout equal to the backend budget,
  # the hop timed out first and the retry replayed the whole CPU
  # generation (offline mock, 2026-10-31: two backend requests, then 504
  # at the entry budget). Retry stays for 502/503 only, which the LLM
  # listener returns when vLLM is unreachable or refusing.
  - policies:
      apiKey:
        mode: strict
        keys:
          - key: "$GATEWAY_CLIENT_KEY"
      timeout:
        requestTimeout: 180s
      retry:
        attempts: 1
        backoff: 250ms
        codes: [502,503]
    backends:
      - host: 127.0.0.1:3000
llm:
  port: 3000
  policies:
    timeout:
      requestTimeout: 170s
      backendRequestTimeout: 160s
      responseIdleTimeout: 160s

    localRateLimit:
      - maxTokens: 12
        tokensPerFill: 12
        fillInterval: 1s
        type: requests
        key: llm.requestModel
      - maxTokens: 150000
        tokensPerFill: 150000
        fillInterval: 1h
        type: tokens
        key: llm.requestModel
  models:
    - name: ewallet-fraud-llm-primary
      visibility: internal
      provider:
        custom:
          formats:
            - type: completions
      params:
        model: ewallet-fraud-llm-v1
        baseUrl: http://vllm-primary.ewallet-agents.svc.cluster.local:8000/v1
        apiKey: "$VLLM_API_KEY"
      health:
        eviction:
          consecutiveFailures: 2
          duration: 30s
      responseHeaders:
        set:
          x-ewallet-backend: primary
    - name: ewallet-fraud-llm-fallback
      visibility: internal
      provider:
        custom:
          formats:
            - type: completions
      params:
        model: ewallet-fraud-llm-v1
        baseUrl: http://vllm-fallback.ewallet-agents.svc.cluster.local:8000/v1
        apiKey: "$VLLM_API_KEY"
      health:
        eviction:
          consecutiveFailures: 2
          duration: 30s
      responseHeaders:
        set:
          x-ewallet-backend: fallback
  virtualModels:
    - name: ewallet-fraud-llm
      routing:
        failover:
          targets:
            - {model: ewallet-fraud-llm-primary, priority: 0}
            - {model: ewallet-fraud-llm-fallback, priority: 1}
